name: CountUp
docs: A figure that counts from zero to `value` when it first comes into view. Without script, and under a reduced-motion preference, it shows `value` at once; the figure in the markup is always the final one.

svelte.reason: motion needs timers, animation frames or media APIs and a reduced-motion rule; it is written by the programmer behind this contract
